title: RANDY FELTFACE
tickerText:
RANDY FELTFACE IS THE PURPLE PUPPET COMEDY SENSATION WHO HAS TAKEN THE WORLD BY STORM! WITH HIS RAZOR-SHARP WIT, SAVAGE OBSERVATIONS AND HILARIOUS EXISTENTIAL MELTDOWNS, RANDY HAS BECOME ONE OF THE MOST DISTINCTIVE AND BELOVED ACTS ON THE INTERNATIONAL COMEDY CIRCUIT.

WITH OVER 20 YEARS IN COMEDY, RANDY HAS PERFORMED SOLD-OUT SHOWS ACROSS THE GLOBE, RELEASED MULTIPLE STAND-UP SPECIALS AND ATTRACTED A MASSIVE ONLINE FOLLOWING.

AS SEEN ON NETFLIX AND NBC'S BRING THE FUNNY, RANDY HAS BEEN NOMINATED FOR BEST COMEDY AT THE EDINBURGH FRINGE AND PERFORMED AT THE PRESTIGIOUS JUST FOR LAUGHS FESTIVAL IN MONTREAL.

FROM HIS AWARD-WINNING PARTNERSHIP WITH SAMMY J TO HIS LEGENDARY SOLO PERFORMANCES, RANDY DELIVERS AN EXPLOSIVE MIX OF BRILLIANT STORYTELLING, BRUTAL HONESTY, LIGHTNING-FAST CROWD WORK AND GLORIOUSLY ABSURD HUMOUR.

HE'S PURPLE. HE'S OPINIONATED. HE'S COMPLETELY UNHINGED. AND HE'S PROOF THAT YOU DON'T NEED TO BE HUMAN TO BE ABSOLUTELY HILARIOUS!
